text: What if Earth's gravity doubled… every single hour?
Here's the rule: Earth gets twice as heavy every hour. Same size, just heavier, so it pulls twice as hard.
Hour zero. A normal day. Watch how high this ball bounces.
You weigh twice as much. Every stair you climb is like carrying a second you on your back.
Same ball, same throw: half as high.
Even the trees feel it. Every branch hangs a little lower.
Hour ten: a thousand times. Hour twenty: a million.
Doing the math with me? Tap like and follow.
Hour two: four times your weight. And by hour twenty… there's no Earth left.
